verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a self-hosting option ('Run it in our cloud or self-host it on your infrastructure') with a Docker setup, so users can keep their data wherever they deploy it. Unleash Edge keeps targeting PII inside the Edge node and never sends it to the cloud. External impact metrics are queried at read time and stay in the user's own system. However, nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection for the hosted cloud. missing for 10: documented cloud region/data-residency choice (e.g., EU/US hosting), residency/compliance documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run it in our cloud or self-host it on your infrastructure.
This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. The data stays in your system.
